name: Plant Therapy Tingly Mint (Green) Synergy Essential Oil 100% Pure, Undiluted, Therapeutic Grade
description: 100% PURE, UNDILUTED TINGLY MINT SYNERGY Formulated by our expert Aromatherapists, Plant Therapy only uses 100% pure, undiluted essential oils to create powerful therapeutic synergy blends that are useful and effective. Tingly Mint Synergy contains the high-quality essential oils of Peppermint, Orange Sweet, Wintergreen, and Grapefruit Pink. MINTY GOODNESS THAT IS ENERGIZING AND UPLIFTING The minty goodness of Peppermint and Wintergreen combine perfectly with the citrusy oils of Orange Sweet and Grapefruit Pink to bring you a synergy blend that is zesty, energizing, and absolutely wonderful. The aroma of Tingly Mint is uplifting and energizing to the senses, but use it for your hair or foot care and you will never go back! An invigorating foot scrub using Tingly Mint will be the only thing your toes will crave. Add it to your hair care products and your scalp will be singing praises with luscious locks! Tingly Mint is a favorite among many and you will see why when you use it. AMAZING FOOT SOAK Combine one half cup Epsom salts, 1 teaspoon of your favorite Plant Therapy carrier oil and 10 drops Tingly Mint to a basin of warm water; soak your feet and scrub with the mixture for an invigorating foot scrub soak after a long day on your feet. AFFORDABLE, HIGH-QUALITY ESSENTIAL OILS Our goal at Plant Therapy is to positively impact the lives of as many people as humanly possible. By selling such a high quality product at an affordable price, we not only positively affect the lives of our customers, it also gives us the financial means by which we can help those who are less fortunate to live a happier, healthier, and more productive life. Size: 10 ml.

name: Plant Therapy Relaxation Synergy Set 100% Pure, Undiluted, Size: 3 - mL
description: Plant Therapy has created a set with our customers in mind. We want you to relax. Relax from all your daily worries and enjoy a moment or two just for you. Whether this is used in a relaxing bath at home, a stolen moment in your car, a time of meditation, or to create a peaceful atmosphere while at home or work, we have created a set that will help you unwind, relax, and promote personal reflection. This set contains 10 ml each of the synergy blends of Meditation, Relax, and Tranquil. Each of these three remarkable oils have incredible therapeutic properties to help evoke a calm alertness, relax physically, and relax mentally to help you obtain a state of mind that is calming and help you feel at ease. Easy to use, and beneficial to your overall well being the Relaxation Set will help you feel at your best when you take the moment to relax, reflect, and unwind. Meditation is specially formulated with Ylang Ylang, Patchouli, Frankincense, Clary Sage, Sweet Orange, and Thyme. These amazing oils together help evoke a calm alertness, taking you into a calmer, more meditative state of mind. Relax synergy blend is created with Lavender, Marjoram, Mandarin, Patchouli, Geranium, and Roman Chamomile to help promote physical relaxation. Tranquil is made up of Bergamot, Patchouli, Blood Orange, Ylang Ylang, Grapefruit to assist you in achieving mental relaxation, helping you to feel more at ease and bringing about a sense of wellbeing. Size: 3 - mL. Gender: male.
